message: hey cutie 𓆝 𓆟 𓆞 𓆝 𓆟                just wanted to leave you a little note to remind you that i’m always always always rooting for you. i hope you know how much i want to see you succeed in anything you decide to do. whether it’s something big you’ve been working toward or just a small thing you’ve been looking forward to, i want to hear about it, celebrate with you, and support you however i can 𖹭            i know things don’t alwaysss go according to plan, and sometimes you might feel frustrated with yourself or wonder if you’re doing enough. just remember that you don’t have to have everything figured out. you’re allowed to take your time, make mistakes, and change your mind. none of that takes away from what amazing things you’re capable of.            i hope you never ever feel like you have to downplay your accomplishments around me, because i really do want to hear about them. i want to know what you’re excited about, what you’re working on, and everything you hope to do someday. even if i don’t always understand everything you’re talking about (im trying to though!!), i’ll always still happily listen.                   also, please remember to take care of yourself along the way :( you deserve to enjoy the things you’re working so hard for, too. don’t ever be too hard on yourself sweetheart           i guess what i’m trying to say is that i’m always on your side. i want good things for you, and i’ll always be happy to remind you that i believe in you.                   okay, that’s enough mushy stuff for today. just wanted you to know. <3
